limits: LSR QUALIFIER letters E and M are not defined on the IEM pages read; use them as coded. E-coded rows often name a station or a measurement (88 of 394), for example VALID 202010311117 is coded E with the remark "MT DOT/MESONET REPORT." A web search found no definition of the letters.

LSR MAG is treated as mph (remark checks), but the unit is not stated in the CSV; treat as unverified until IEM confirms. Reviewer remark test: 1,115 of 1,333 remarks giving an mph value match MAG; none of the 9 knots remarks equals MAG in knots.

IEM daily max_wind_gust_kts: the form says knots but does not name the observation source (METAR gust or PK WND); three values at or above 130 kt in 2023 are not plausible for these sites; quality control is required.
PK WND peak gusts are sparse in the June 2025 sample (1,142 of 26,951 station-hours); the METAR gust field (4,445 rows) is better filled but still hourly-ish.

NCEI: the 2026 file ends 2026-06-30 23:49 for every state (reviewer), so July 2026 onward is absent; NCEI times are local. No High Wind row (2,968 events, 2020 to 2026) has a begin or end coordinate in the details or locations files, so High Wind counts are zone or county-level evidence only; every Thunderstorm Wind row has a begin point.

SPC: 2026 rows are preliminary daily reports (410 rows); the archive format note is dated 2010 on its header; the 2025 file changed the om format (changelog 24 Apr 2026), and the changelog does not mention wind fields. Wind speeds in knots; UNK appears in 2026 daily files (20 rows).

DAT: the bounding-box counts include Wyoming and South Dakota features. Montana counts use the Census 1:500,000 state outline (reviewer): 64 points, 5 lines (start point), 4 polygons; window 20 points (all 2022), 1 line, 0 polygons. DAT points are NWS damage survey observations, not roof inspections or damage findings. Windspeed and maxwind units are not documented; -99 is a sentinel in maxwind; 'N/A' appears in windspeed.

HRRR GUST is a model analysis, not an observation; the Benchland and crop values are model values. Hourly sampling can miss gusts between analysis times. The GUST definition (instantaneous or interval) was not confirmed from HRRR documentation.

HRRR full-window pull was not done (cap and time): 43,824 records at about 1.16 MB each is about 50.6 GB of range reads. A storm-day subset (about 9,288 hours) is about 10.7 GB; the sample check covered 30 random hours and the 2025-06-15 day only.

Montana crop for HRRR (43.0 to 50.5 N, 118.5 to 101.0 W) comes from the brief and includes Wyoming, Idaho, the Dakotas and southern Canada. Reviewer masking with the Census outline keeps 43,209 of 126,333 cells; the box maximum lies outside Montana (see the Montana-only fact).
Storm-day union counts depend on local versus UTC day boundaries (NCEI local; LSR UTC; SPC report date); they are approximate.
The 5-year window used here is 2021-10-17 to 2026-10-17 (the brief lists 2020 to 2025 for some sources; 2020 calendar-year data are included in the year tables).

Skipped (cap and time): the full 43,824-hour HRRR GUST pull and any HRRR forecast-hour GUST fields; a 5-year raw ASOS pull (only one month sampled); the full IEM 1-minute data; NCEI location and fatality files; DAT attribute review beyond the 127 features; the Herbie package (listed, not installed); daily SPC pages before 2026 (the archive zip was used instead); HRRR availability for every hour (30 random hours checked).
Request limits for the IEM CGI endpoints are not documented; about 530 requests were made in total with no rate-limit errors seen.

Recommended minimum set (judgment from the figures above): (1) NCEI Storm Events details for Montana Thunderstorm Wind (point coordinates) and High Wind (zone level), 2021 to 2026, using MAGNITUDE_TYPE; (2) IEM LSR wind codes G, N, A, D, O for recent reports and remarks, deduplicated; (3) IEM daily MT_ASOS max gust (knots) for station observations, with a quality-control rule for values at or above 130 kt; (4) SPC wind archive plus 2026 daily reports as a second point-report source; (5) DAT damage survey points inside the Montana boundary as official survey evidence (not roof findings); (6) HRRR GUST only as an optional labelled model field, starting with the storm-day subset.
NCEI 2023 details: one event on 2023-12-31 across all states, against 48 to 189 on that date in other years; the effect on Montana is not measured.
IEM LSR monthly files change while the month is open (202610 gained 3 wind rows between pulls); record the pull date with every count.
IEM ASOS June 2025 sample covers 38 stations with rows; a five-year raw pull is not measured (about 54 MB is an extrapolation from one month).
open_questions: DAT: what are the units of windspeed (text field) and maxwind, what does "N/A" mean, and what are the terms of use for the services?
IEM: what do the LSR QUALIFIER letters mean in the CSV, is MAG always mph, and which observation feeds max_wind_gust_kts? A web search did not confirm the NWS definition.

IEM daily gust: what quality control do the 130 kt-plus values need (SDY 2023-08-06 at 255.0 kt is a candidate sentinel)? Also check the 2024 maximum of 104.0 kt and the 2025 maximum of 105.1 kt (121 mph at HVR 2025-02-20).
NCEI: when will July to October 2026 events appear? The 2026 file has no event in any state after 2026-06-30; SPC preliminary daily files list 248 Montana wind reports dated July to September 2026.
HRRR: GUST height and averaging are not confirmed; the GRIB2 step type is instant (reviewer). Two NCEP HRRR pages were fetched without a GUST definition.
Which storm-day subset rule should set the HRRR pull (the TSTM-type union gives 387 days; adding High Wind gives 655)?
pygrib: confirm the upstream licence of the 2.1.8 expression 'MIT AND (Apache-2.0 OR BSD-2-Clause)' before build use.
IEM: do MT_RWIS, MT_DCP and MT_COOP report gusts for 2021 to 2026? MT_RWIS station MABR returned no June 2025 rows.
DAT: is the Montana polygon with event_id 'kjhg' (2018-07-14, TSTM/Wind) a test record?

review.scope: Refutation pass over W5. Fresh downloads: NCEI 2025 and 2026 details and locations; IEM LSR (73 months), daily 2020 to 2026, June 2025 ASOS sample and network lists; SPC archive, 2025 CSV, changelog, PDF and 290 daily 2026 files; DAT queries and polygon geometry; HRRR index files (24 hours plus 2 endpoints) and GUST ranges (23Z, 01Z). Saved copies were hashed, size-matched or recounted; Montana tests use the Census 1:500,000 outline; terms pages re-read. Reviewer downloads 82.3 MB (total with the researcher 245.7 MB, under the 300 MB cap). Not re-downloaded: NCEI 2020 to 2024 details (sizes matched; counts from saved copies) and the SPC description PDF page images.
refuted_claims: DAT box counts labelled as Montana (109 points, 12 lines, 6 polygons; window 36, 3, 2) include Wyoming and South Dakota. Montana: 64 points, 5 lines (start point), 4 polygons; window 20 points (all 2022), 1 line, 0 polygons.
DAT brief period 2020 to 2025 'points 40, lines 5': from 2020-10-01 the box gives 36 points, 3 lines, 2 polygons; the four 2020 points and two 2020 lines are dated before October 2020.
HRRR 'Montana crop' day maximum 26.13 m/s at 23Z: the value reproduces, but at 44.006 N, 105.58 W (Wyoming). Montana-only maximum is 22.64 m/s at 22Z; no Montana cell reached 25 m/s on 2025-06-15.

IEM LSR 'McCone' QUALIFIER and the field-shift example VALID 202212221055: the malformed wind row is VALID 202308190245 (TYPECODE G, GGW) with QUALIFIER M; VALID 202212221055 is an extreme wind chill record (TYPECODE 7).
IEM ASOS June 2025 sample 'for the 60 stations' and 'bytes 1624': 38 stations returned rows; the file is 907,359 bytes (1,624 bytes is the BIL test file).
pygrib 'no licence field': the PyPI record has license_expression 'MIT AND (Apache-2.0 OR BSD-2-Clause)'; the legacy license field is null and there is no License classifier.

NCEI 2026 'Montana events run only to 2026-06-29' as a Montana gap: the whole 2026 file ends 2026-06-30 23:49 for every state; SPC daily files list 248 Montana wind reports dated July to September 2026.
NCEI High Wind magnitude breakdown: ES 1 omitted for 2021 and 2026 (sums 544 and 409 against totals 545 and 410).
NCEI SOURCE label 'Department of Highwa': cut at 20 characters; the source text is 'Department of Highways' (130 rows reproduce).
NOAA attribution quotes "come from another registry entry": the four sentences are on the HRRR registry page; the NOAA NODD page has none of them.
corrections: urls_checked ASOS June 2025: bytes 1624 corrected to 907359; now 38 of 60 requested stations with rows.

Facts changed (corrected_from or refuted_by): High Wind ES 1; SOURCE label; LSR G qualifier M 2952; field-shift example; ASOS station count; DAT box label and Montana values; DAT window; DAT by year; HRRR crop box and Montana maximum; NCEI file-lag evidence.
Limits, open questions and terms replaced or added for DAT, NCEI 2026 and 2023, HRRR crop, LSR remark test, the live LSR month and the pygrib licence; NOAA quote note corrected.
Vendor naming: a product name in urls_checked and in the DAT program entry was replaced with generic service wording; host names inside URLs are unchanged.
IEM daily: 'stations' means stations with a numeric gust that year. The window label should read 2021-10-17 to 2026-10-17 (1,264 reproduced; calendar 2021 to 2026 sums to 1,449).
IEM counts are as of the pulls: live month 202610 added 3 N rows; daily 2026 numeric is 10,382 on the reviewer pull (10,378 at the pull); 2020 to 2025 identical.
SPC changelog: the 24 Apr 2026 entry changes the om_number format (2007 to present), not an 'om format'; no wind-field change in that entry.
confirmed: NCEI details 2025 and 2026 fresh, MD5 equal; 2020 to 2024 sizes equal; seven files sum to 78,483,844 B. Montana Thunderstorm Wind 235, 206, 300, 135, 299, 309, 159 (window 1,208); High Wind 472, 545, 562, 244, 435, 300, 410 (window 2,155); Strong Wind 12, 18, 6, 0, 8, 14, 11.
NCEI README and format quotes verbatim (PDF text layer); magnitude types and knots definition; file-lag dates match.
SPC archive 562,088 rows; Montana by year 230, 235, 206, 299, 135, 299, 318; MG 1,271 and EG 451 (2019 to 2025); window 1,057; 2025 CSV 318; magnitudes 43 to 100 kt.
SPC wcm quotes verbatim. SPC 2026 daily: 290 files, 3,868,310 B, 64 header-only, 410 Montana rows, 390 numeric speeds (58 to 94 kt) and 20 UNK.
2025-06-15 Montana cross-check: NCEI Thunderstorm Wind 24, SPC 20, IEM LSR G 7.

IEM LSR 73 months: G 3,163 clean (3,164 with the malformed row), N 21,922, A 634, D 295, O 263, M 6, B 2; window G 2,733, A 594, D 238, O 199, M 1, B 2; duplicates 259 and 266; E-coded 88 of 394 at pull. Logged bytes sum to 163,423,490 over 530 requests.

IEM disclaimer quotes verbatim; daily gust 'Maximum wind gust in knots'; numeric-gust station counts and at-or-above 50 and 40 kt counts by year reproduce; window at or above 50 kt 1,264; outliers 255.0, 182.49 (210 mph), 165.11 (190 mph).
IEM MT_ASOS: 60 features, 42 online, 41 begun by 2021-10-17; WFO counts; other MT networks counted in the new facts.
DAT box counts and date filters reproduce; 15 of 109 point windspeeds N/A; 3 of 12 lines maxwind -99; layer copyright fields empty.

HRRR: 24 GUST record sizes (min 1,068,144; max 1,263,256; mean 1,155,219.4); endpoints 1,169,958 and 1,298,829; 30 of 30 random index files have a GUST line; decode gives crop cells 126,333, Benchland cell 0.916 km away, 9.07 m/s at 01Z; job arithmetic 50.6 GB, 10.7 GB, 18.2 GB.
HRRR registry and rapidrefresh quotes verbatim; NWS disclaimer verbatim; eccodes Apache-2.0 and herbie-data MIT confirmed.
unverified: IEM LSR QUALIFIER letters E and M: no definition on the IEM pages read; a web search found no confirmed definition. Use as coded.
IEM LSR MAG unit: mph is supported by the remark tests but is not documented by IEM.
IEM daily max_wind_gust_kts source (METAR gust or peak wind) is not documented; the mph pattern shows part of the values came from mph reports converted to knots.
DAT windspeed and maxwind units; the meaning of N/A; DAT terms of use beyond the empty layer metadata.
HRRR GUST height and averaging period: the GRIB2 step type is instant (from message keys); NCEP documentation not confirmed.
The Census 1:500,000 outline is generalized; DAT points within about 1 km of the border may be misclassified.
NCEI 2023 last day: whether events after 05:35 on 2023-12-31 are missing (not measured).
IEM RWIS, DCP and COOP wind fields: not checked (MT_RWIS station MABR returned no June 2025 rows from daily.py or asos.py).
SPC description PDF field meanings and the 2010 header date: page images not re-read (PDF metadata creation date 2016-03-07).
Five-year raw ASOS size: only one June month measured (907,359 B); the 54 MB figure is an extrapolation.
